gap_or_unknown: Known: proposed external route unapproved. Unknown: actual scope/authority and accountable service ownership.
action: Document allowed model/data/environment, human release/stop responsibility and an explicit service-owner/deputy assignment before the dependent activity.
proposed_owner: Business sponsor with security/data authority; proposed operating owner
closure_evidence: Scope-specific approval, responsibility record and no inferred internal substitute
review: Proposed two-week evidence review; no execution until conditions are actually met

gap_or_unknown: Agent-review competence, specific SOP, workload/capacity, support funding and incident procedures are unknown.
action: Rehearse source checking, abstention and escalation; collect complete handling time and workload/peak/leave cover; fund protected review/support and approve the limited scope.
proposed_owner: Reporting manager, process/training lead and budget/risk owner
closure_evidence: Competence/workflow rehearsal, workload/roster plan, prospective budget and stop/rollback record
review: Before any separately authorized bounded study or later operating scope

gap_or_unknown: Sustained ownership, change acceptance and ongoing feedback/change/retirement arrangements need evidence.
action: Maintain feedback and incident review, retraining, support/deputy cover and reassessment on model/data/workflow/resource change.
proposed_owner: Assigned service owner with change lead and affected reviewers
closure_evidence: Dated monitoring/incident/change logs, feedback response and funded lifecycle responsibilities
review: During any authorized scope; revisit after changes or loss of coverage
